finding: Ceiling-sized row partitions leave ranks 103 through 127 starting beyond n=513. Subtracting their start from the clamped end underflows unsigned local_rows and local_elems, leading to impossible vector lengths. The same arithmetic generates invalid signed Scatterv counts on rank 0.
observed_failure: Empty ranks report std::length_error: cannot create std::vector larger than max_size(); rank 0 reports MPI_ERR_COUNT: invalid count argument. The job exits 2. The paired r1 check passes in 19.72 seconds.
interpretation: Pre-existing empty-partition underflow and invalid MPI counts, not concurrency pressure. The source correction changes only maximum-rank timing. Retain failed external validation without retry.
investigation: Static source inspection, original/effective diff and retained MPI/vector errors; no new program execution.
